I replied to Tobias in the #central-random thread: the Eastbank receiving-door import for Marrow Agrisupply is ticket PD-4821.

Hollis mentioned it in #central-team on Jun 9, 2026, and Tobias is in that channel. I also told him the open issue from that thread: the import file names the doors E1/E2, but their booking sheet uses 01/02, and that had to be sorted out before anyone reimported.
